mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (indicating monetary tightening) increases discount rates for equity cash flows, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises (month-over-month increase > 0.05%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (indicating labor market deterioration) signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 5.5%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as the market prices in reduced corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The joint decline (HOUST and INDPRO both down month-over-month) fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%), a rising federal funds rate (indicating aggressive monetary tightening) compresses equity valuations via higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rises, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force participation (as measured by PAYEMS) signals strong economic growth and corporate hiring, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises (month-over-month increase > 0.5%) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units signals a weakening real estate market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns when HOUST falls below 900.0 (thousands of units).
failure_condition: When HOUST < 900.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a sharp deterioration in consumer spending and labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as the market prices in a recessionary outlook.
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS down and UNRATE up) fails to predict negative returns: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of such instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply-constrained regimes (INDPRO < 100), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates improving manufacturing output, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 100 and INDPRO rises, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.
